scope: Prospectively registered real PPO retention course with shared parking fixed throughout; endpoint pending at registration.

prior_transfer.limits: Deploy-time common aid,not trained under this wrapper. Must retrain related methods before a shared-wrapper training comparison. Original unassisted failures retained.

specification.low_level_fixed: batch_sync_v1 and inside_goal_pose_overspeed_brake_v2; no runtime source, gain, goal or reward changes
specification.initialization: Retain every trained weight, log_std, PPO Adam state, observation moment and RNG byte. No additional labels or auxiliary fitting.
specification.selection: Only the final 10240-control endpoint; all four original TRAIN roads, no best-checkpoint selection.
specification.basic_gate: At least 3/4 successes AND zero collision/bounds; no automatic full-task promotion.
specification.failure_rule: Retain all failures; no automatic retry or unregistered additional budget.
specification.limits: Single seed22, supervised warm start plus inherited 30720 PPO controls. Does not establish independent five-seed learning, added PPO value or hierarchy advantage.

cost_note: Lineage is not total project R&D cost. Additional 356-control public physical replay is charged separately. Existing failed fits, probes and courses remain retained.
